title: Container registry
description: Azure Container Registry with the admin account and anonymous pull disabled (Entra ID only). Premium adds private-only access, a private endpoint and zone redundancy.
security_defaults: Admin user disabled; anonymous pull disabled: Entra ID RBAC only (AcrPull / AcrPush)
Public access is ON by default because turning it off needs the Premium SKU; the strict (production) policy requires Premium with public access off

sku.description: Registry tier. Premium is required for private networking.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Reachable from the internet. false needs Premium.

zone_redundancy_enabled.description: Zone redundancy (Premium). Cannot be changed later.

private_dns_zone_id.description: privatelink.azurecr.io zone for the private endpoint.
